first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A foreground open-wheel race car, with a dark blue nose that narrows toward the front, two black front wheels, and black suspension partially visible; there are red markings on the tire sidewalls.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray paved surface in front of Vehicle A, extending along a right-hand bend, with dark tire marks on its surface.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: A large area of light blue sky in the upper part of the image, paler near the horizon, with soft, thin clouds in places.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: A narrow alternating red-and-white strip extending along the boundary between the road surface and the grass strip on the inside of the right-hand bend.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low green grass strips on both sides of the racetrack and the grassy slopes outside the safety barriers.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: Rows or clusters of trees around the outside of the road, with green crowns of varying heights and some trunks visible.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: Continuous low, light-colored walls extending along both sides of the road, with an orange wall section or green advertising surface in places on the left.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: Fencing around the outside of the road, composed of dark gray vertical posts, horizontal lines, and metal mesh, with a relatively great visible height on the right side of the image.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: Groups of rectangular signs around the outside of the road, including green sign faces and distant large rectangular screen faces with supports.
